daypart_morning_eu: Band boundaries: Unicode CLDR 47 Day Period Rules, locale eu
transcribed in chronologia/dayparts.py as the morning band.
Surface: inessive 'goizean' — in the morning -- the deictic form these phrases use.
absolutive "goiza" after a -ko day word ("biharko goiza"): Wiktionary, goiz
daypart_night_eu: Band boundaries: Unicode CLDR 47 Day Period Rules, locale eu
transcribed in chronologia/dayparts.py as the night band.
Surface: inessive 'gauean' — at night -- the deictic form these phrases use.
absolutive "gaua" after a -ko day word ("atzoko gaua"): Wiktionary, gaua.
"gau honetan" (in this night) is tonight: eu.wikipedia "Walpurgis gaua"
("gau honetan sorginak bildu ohi baitziren"); Wiktionary, honetan.
marker_dayparttoday: a night surface fused with TODAY, as English "tonight" is.
